data.body: **[P1] Keep execution output resolution lazy.** Resolving here requires storage access even for status/history-only inspection. The existing three-argument overload supplies no ARN and now throws for envelopes; additionally, the new EFS cloud test has no local offloader while the example always offloads its root output, so `runner.run()` fails before its assertions. Retain a resolver in `TestResult` and resolve only from `getResult()`, failing closed there. Add status-only reference-envelope coverage.
